name: Orca Scan
description:
Create and manage enterprise-ready barcode systems directly from Claude.

Tell Claude what you want to track, and it creates the first version of your barcode system with the right fields, data types and barcode scanning already configured, powered by Orca Scan.
Query and update data, generate barcode labels, customise your system, and manage everything through a conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Orca Scan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Orca Scan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.orcascan.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Orca Scan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orca Scan lists 37 MCP tools, including orca_fields_create, orca_fields_delete, orca_fields_get, orca_fields_list, orca_fields_update, orca_history_row, orca_history_sheet, orca_hooks_create, orca_hooks_delete, orca_hooks_events, orca_hooks_get, and orca_hooks_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Orca Scan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Orca Scan in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Orca Scan MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orca Scan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Orca Scan is developed by Orca Scan. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
